description: Chemicals Management Plan Wastewater Monitoring Program is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environment and Climate Change Canada | Environnement et Changement climatique Canada. In 2006, the Government of Canada initiated the Chemicals Management Plan (CMP), which takes action regarding chemicals that are harmful to human health or the environment. One element of the CMP is Monitoring and Surveillance, which generates data on the presence and levels of chemical substances in environmental matrices. Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Environment and Climate Change Canada | Environnement et Changement climatique Canada. Its tags are Waste water, Wastewater, Sludge, Biosolids, Treatment. It offers 7 resource(s) in CSV, HTML. The portal shows 2024-06-09 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
